pageTitle: Klacks for Home Care | Route Planning & Care Scheduling

hero.titleHtml: More time for care, less for route planning.
hero.subtitle: Klacks schedules visits and routes automatically — with the right qualifications, correct pay premiums, and your canton's public holidays. On-premise, so patient data never leaves your building.
hero.screenshotAlt: Klacks timeline view for home care route planning
hero.screenshotCaption: Screenshot shown in German — the app itself is also available in English.

items.title: Routes instead of shifts
items.text: Every caregiver drives from client to client. Routes, sequence, and time windows all have to fit together — freshly, every single day.

items.title: Qualification decides
items.text: Medication administration, wound care, degree level: not everyone is allowed to take on every visit.

items.title: Sensitive data
items.text: Patient data needs to be protected. A mandatory cloud is not an option for many organizations.

solutions.title: How Klacks lightens the load for home care
solutions.subtitle: From automatic routes to cantonal public holidays — it all works together.

items.title: Routes optimized automatically
items.text: Klacks lays out visit routes so distances stay short and time windows are met — by car, bike, or on foot.

items.title: Qualifications automatically respected
items.text: Every visit is assigned only to people with the right qualification — with no manual checking at all.

items.title: Pay premiums & public holidays for your canton
items.text: Night, weekend, and public holiday premiums come pre-configured — down to canton and municipality level, and freely adjustable.

items.title: On-premise: data stays in-house
items.text: Klacks runs on your own infrastructure. Patient data never leaves your building — not even for the AI.

items.title: Klacksy schedules by voice
items.text: “Fill tomorrow's routes” is enough. If someone calls in sick, Klacksy immediately suggests available replacements.

items.title: Absences covered fast
items.text: If someone drops out, Klacks immediately shows who's qualified and available — without turning the whole schedule upside down.

example.title: Home care in Geneva, bilingual, with visits in Vaud
example.text: French-language interface, Geneva and Vaud public holidays, home care pay premiums — configured in Klacks, not custom-coded. Routes are optimized automatically, qualifications are checked, and Klacksy helps with last-minute changes. Patient data stays entirely in-house throughout.

cta.title: Experience Klacks in your home care organization
cta.text: In a personal demo, we'll show you how Klacks handles routes, qualifications, and pay premiums for your organization.
